title: Token map reconciliation and template gating for smoother model onboarding
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Background: New model vendors and open checkpoints keep introducing tokenization quirks (subtoken splits, whitespace normalization, special role markers) that cause subtle chat template misalignment and noisy latency regressions during inference. During recent onboards we saw two customer incidents where prompts were clipped or role delimiters duplicated after model pin upgrades. Goal: Build a reconciliation step in the onboarding pipeline that produces a canonical token map, a templating compatibility shim when needed, and a gate that prevents publishing the performance profile until compatibility checks pass. This ticket implements the reconciliation algorithm, the gating rules, and the publishing flow for runtime performance profiles.
acceptance_criteria: Onboarding pipeline produces a "canonical_token_map.json" artifact for each model, with documented checksum and tokenizer metadata
Automated template compatibility checker runs and reports pass/fail for the model + selected customer templates
If compatibility fails, profile publish is blocked and an explanatory failure artifact (diffs + example tokens) is emitted
Ship an opt-in template compatibility shim that can be toggled per-deployment; integration tests cover shim on/off behavior
Console shows the compatibility status and the token map artifact link on the model page
steps: Add tokenizer normalization step that extracts subtoken boundaries, special token set, and whitespace policy from huggingface + internal shims
Implement reconciliation logic to map model tokenizer tokens -> canonical token ids used by our prompt templates
Create a template compatibility checker that re-runs representative prompt sets through the tokenizer and compares expected role boundaries
Define gating policy: fail publish if >0.5% of prompts change role boundaries or if any template truncation occurs
Expose a lightweight shim that rewrites problematic delimiters (configurable rules), controlled by deployment-level flag
Integrate into publish pipeline: artifact storage (S3), console link, and automatic rollback hook for flagged releases
Add integration tests and a smoke test harness for canary model pinning scenarios
decisions: Use tokenizer libs from HF tokenizers where available and fall back to our micro-tokenizer for edge cases (decision made 2025-02-28 by Marco)
Gating thresholds set conservatively initially (0.5% boundary diffs) to avoid noisy failures; can be tuned after 2 weeks of telemetry
Shim will be opt-in for new private deployments and enabled by default for Hosted as a safe fallback until upstream fixes land
blockers: Need finalized canonical prompt sets from PM for enterprise customers (waiting on PM-4211)
Access to one vendor tokenizer binary that requires a license; legal review in progress
